High-resolution (600 dpi) image of strangewayes' print-ready errata card for [[Beedo (PC Errata 4)]] (the card with its Players Committee errata text and the errata mark) (Jabba's Palace, Dark Side), from [[Strangewayes|strangewayes]]' [[Fan projects#HiRez scanning project|HiRez scanning project]].

Source: strangewayes' HiRez scanning project — forum thread [https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t65510.html HiRez scanning duty (t65510)] and the project's Google Drive folder [https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/12i00KRLriVraozX2i8MVLKHm4HJnQPB0 STAR WARS CCG], file <code>Errata/Dark_E/Beedo _ E.tif</code> ([https://drive.google.com/file/d/1EPYhRF2xUBtkov7aOEakYRstyf7eFgEl/view Drive file]).

Original TIFF: <code>Beedo _ E.tif</code>, 1497×2073 px at 600 dpi, 9,339,664 bytes, SHA-256 <code>067cf8724633cc34e0a9be9694aee3a2e274b07b344b808903995ae119d5a5c3</code>. The TIFF is kept unchanged as the master copy on the swccg.com server.

Changes from the TIFF: converted to WebP (quality 90); the card's rounded corners masked to transparent (anti-aliased; corner radii measured from the image, 46.0, 47.5, 74.0, 56.5 px); resized: no; no other change.

This credited gold-E print-ready fan recreation remains a qualified comparison. It is not an automatic same-image high-resolution scan of the official D-E1 full source at [[Beedo (PC Errata 4)]]. Original TIFF, master, credit and license provenance remain unchanged.

Credit: image by strangewayes for the HiRez scanning project; used here with credit to that project. Fair use rationale: this is an image of a copyrighted Star Wars Customizable Card Game card, © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc. (card design by the Players Committee). It is used only to identify and study the card on this non-commercial fan wiki, it does not replace any product sold today, and no free equivalent exists.
